summary: Well‑executed, preregistered paired experiment comparing a single LLM generation observed with and without a deterministic validator+gate under shared_initial_candidate semantics. Execution and archival artifacts are comprehensive; the confirmatory estimand is implemented as registered and yields a degenerate null (all 200 shared initial candidates valid). No unsupported scientific claims detected, but manuscript-level fixes are required for disclosure concision and reference formatting.
required_revisions: Condense the mandatory Disclosure Statement to be concise and non‑redundant: keep exactly one immutable master_prompt locator + its full SHA‑256, retain the preregistration identifier (no prereg SHA required), and remove or relocate per‑episode hashes, provider‑call logs, and extensive execution paths from the Disclosure into the archived artifact bundle with a short pointer in the Disclosure (resolvable from supplied artifacts).

Ensure the References section is a conventional IEEE‑style numbered bibliography containing full bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/URL where applicable) for every cited work referenced in the prose. Replace any bare DOI/arXiv/identifier entries in the manuscript References with full records using the archived BibTeX/metadata artifacts so that each numbered citation in text unambiguously maps to a supporting reference.

Add a short, explicit statement in Methods (or a boxed note immediately after Methods) that explains the shared_initial_candidate execution semantics and the direct consequence for the primary estimand: baseline and guarded arms were applied to the identical sampled candidate per pair (so the confirmatory contrast tests only validator/repair/gate effects on the same initial candidate and does not measure guarded‑conditioned regeneration, prompt engineering, or multi‑sample model variance). This wording should appear in the Abstract and Introduction if not already phrased with identical clarity (resolvable using archived model_configuration.json and execution/provider_call audit artifacts).
optional_revisions: Briefly discuss the statistical/interpretive implications of a degenerate paired contingency (n11=200, n10=n01=n00=0), including why the bootstrap percentile CI collapsed to [0.0,0.0] and any implications for power calculations or recommended alternative estimands/designs in follow‑up work (can cite archived analysis_log.jsonl).

For reader convenience, include a 1/2‑column summary table (or single paragraph) in the main manuscript giving per‑label task difficulty counts (very_hard / extreme) drawn from the archived task_manifest.jsonl so readers can assess sample composition without retrieving artifacts; archive remains authoritative and the manuscript summary should be explicitly labeled as derived from the archived manifest.

Clarify the temperature/sampling semantics in Methods by quoting the archived model_configuration.json (temperature=null) and noting that null does not imply deterministic model sampling—this will reduce potential misinterpretation.
